# Keyboard

<!-- Generated by crates/symbolon-app/ui/scripts/build-keymap-doc.ts from src/lib/keyboard/keymap.ts; run `pnpm keymap-doc` instead of editing. -->

Everything works from the keyboard. Standard keys and vi-style keys work side by side; there is no separate mode. `Ctrl` also means the Command key on macOS. Sequences such as `g l` are typed one key after the other, within a second.

Single-letter keys and sequences never act while text is being typed (in a field, the command palette, or during IME composition); chords with Ctrl or Alt still do. Press `?` for this list in the app.

## Everywhere

| Keys            | Action                         |
| --------------- | ------------------------------ |
| `Ctrl+K`        | Open the command palette       |
| `?`             | Show keyboard shortcuts        |
| `Esc`           | Close or cancel                |
| `Ctrl+1`, `g l` | Go to Locations                |
| `Ctrl+2`, `g s` | Go to Scans                    |
| `Ctrl+3`, `g c` | Go to Compare                  |
| `Ctrl+B`        | Collapse or expand the sidebar |

## In tables and trees

| Keys             | Action                              |
| ---------------- | ----------------------------------- |
| `j`, `↓`         | Next row                            |
| `k`, `↑`         | Previous row                        |
| `h`, `←`         | Collapse folder, or previous column |
| `l`, `→`         | Expand folder, or next column       |
| `g g`, `Home`    | First row                           |
| `Shift+G`, `End` | Last row                            |
| `Ctrl+D`         | Half a page down                    |
| `Ctrl+U`         | Half a page up                      |
| `PageDown`       | Page down                           |
| `PageUp`         | Page up                             |
| `Enter`, `o`     | Open the row                        |
| `Space`, `x`     | Select or deselect the row          |
| `/`              | Filter the list                     |
| `n`              | Next match                          |
| `Shift+N`        | Previous match                      |
